finding.summary: External-login display-name resolution scans the full authentication-scheme snapshot for one provider.
finding.explanation: GetExternalLoginInfoAsync needs the scheme matching the provider name, but calls the virtual GetExternalAuthenticationSchemesAsync method, which obtains the complete scheme snapshot and applies a deferred external-scheme filter, then FirstOrDefault scans it by Name. AuthenticationSchemeProvider already owns a name-keyed dictionary and exposes GetSchemeAsync. The lookup runs during external sign-in processing and scales with the total registered schemes. Any correction must preserve SignInManager override behavior, external-display filtering, duplicate/ordering semantics, and the provider-name fallback.
